explanation: The confrontations’ own article opens its history with this war: “Following the 1948 Arab–Israeli War, the 1949 Armistice Agreements created three demilitarized zones on the Israel-Syria border. The southernmost, and also the largest, stretched from the south-eastern part of the Sea of Galilee eastwards to the Yarmuk River … The issue of water sharing from the Jordan–Yarmuk system turned out to be a major problem between Israel, Syria and Jordan.” The armistice that ended the war is what drew the ground the water was fought over, and the article says the small-scale skirmishes began with those agreements. `precondition-of` and not `caused`: the source makes the war the origin of the line, not of the fight.
